name: Shifter
description: Humanoids with bestial aspects that emerge during a temporary shift.

grants.name: Darkvision
grants.description: You have Darkvision out to 60 feet.

grants.name: Shifting Form
grants.description: Choose the bestial benefit active while you are shifted.

options.name: Beasthide
options.description: Gain additional temporary Hit Points and +1 AC while shifted.

options.name: Longtooth
options.description: Gain a 1d6 Piercing unarmed strike usable as a Bonus Action while shifted.

options.name: Swiftstride
options.description: Gain 10 feet of Speed and a reactive movement while shifted.

options.name: Wildhunt
options.description: Gain Advantage on Wisdom checks and suppress nearby enemy Advantage against you.

grants.name: Shifting
grants.description: As a Bonus Action, shift for 1 minute and gain temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus.
